channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Rajon Rondo | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Rajon Rondo from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Conley on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: Mike Conley:

“Whenever I think of Boston, I think of a winner, a winning culture. Since I was a kid, it's been that way. Since I was in the league, I was a part of the league when KG and them guys won, and Rondo and them, and obviously their last one they won a few years ago. You just think of that immediately. Like PG said, when you walk into the building, there's a sense, there's an atmosphere, there's something that's just a little bit different. You find yourself in there two, three hours, not realizing you've been in there working that much, and just a part of the culture. I think that's initially what I think when I see the Celtics”

Mike Conley on Rajon Rondo, Sep 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
Patrick Beverley:

“I signed a three-year $40 million contract with the Clippers. I turned down a three-year $50 million with Sacramentojust to stay with the Clippers. For me to be there, all the great guards they've had, I was part of that starting five that helped the Clippers go to the first time ever Western Conference Finals. They've had great guards. They've had James Harden, they had Russell Westbrook, they have Chris Paul, they've had Rajon Rondo. They had a plethora of point guards that just can never help them get over the hump, but I was part of that starting five that helped them finally, first time ever, and they haven't been back since, get to the Western Conference Finals.”

Patrick Beverley on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Sep 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Amen Thompson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, John Wall, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I also like how they can command the floor. I’ve been a LeBron, Westbrook and John Wall fan. And then I started watching Rondo and was like, ‘Yo, this man is nice.’ “I knew he was nice, but I didn’t know he was that nice,”

Amen Thompson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, John Wall, Russell Westbrook, Dec 4, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
BucksRealm: Doc Rivers on Rajon Rondo's impact:

“He's been fantastic. I called him this summer and said hey, we need you involved. He watches TONS of film. He's chasing guys down, like, no no no, we're gonna watch film first. Him, Ryan, Cole, Scoot, they just sit and watch film. They hear my voice all the time. It's great for them to hear someone else.”

Doc Rivers on Rajon Rondo, Nov 9, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
LeBron James on Rajon Rondo officially announcing his retirement:

“One of the best players I ever played with. … ‘Do always talked about if he ever teamed up with me, he knew we could win a championship. And we did that”

LeBron James on Rajon Rondo, Apr 2, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
“I will say Rondo looked out. He was the one mostly asking me to go get stuff. He would hand me a couple of dollars when I got back. But, other than that, Bron’s actually real low-maintenance. I think he asked me one time to go get a Xbox remote, so I obviously did that. He gave me a couple of dollars, but they let me escape pretty good.”

Austin Reaves on Rajon Rondo, Mar 25, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Josh Hart on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Josh Hart:

“I've been in the NBA for five years and I've had five coaches. Maybe five and a half if you want to count Bron and Rondo.”

Josh Hart on Rajon Rondo, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
“We made Ray and Rondo actually box it out. They had so much beef, we got to the practice facility, we brought the boxing gloves, and they actually had to box it out, because we just didn’t want to have the tension no more.”

Kendrick Perkins on Rajon Rondo, Jun 27, 2022. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Perkins claimed that things were so toxic between Rondo and Allen that the rest of the team forced them to box at the practice facility to try to settle things.

“When things started to go south, in my opinion, the first incident was Ray pushing so hard to trade Rondo for (Chris Paul).Then it got back to Rondo, and I think right there we started having a little friction,”

Kendrick Perkins on Chris Paul, Rajon Rondo, Jun 27, 2022. Source: Larry Brown Sports.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Kyle Goon:Frank Vogel:

“Rondo means the world to me. He's one of my favorite players I've ever coached.”

Frank Vogel on Rajon Rondo, Jan 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Rajon Rondo, Derek Anderson
item.description:
“I remember guys like [Rajon] Rondo and Derek Anderson, guys like that, giving back to young hoopers like myself.”

D'Angelo Russell on Rajon Rondo, Derek Anderson, Jul 14, 2021. Source: wlky.com.

item.title: Terance Mann on Rajon Rondo, Patrick Beverley, Marcus Morris
item.description:
Terance Mann says hello -- and goodbye for 2020-21:

“Everybody had a hand in my development this season, from top to bottom fro Pat Beverley to Rondo to PG to Kawhi to Serge ... Marcus Morris was a big help.”

Terance Mann on Rajon Rondo, Patrick Beverley, Marcus Morris, Jul 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Carlisle on Rondo playing with the Clippers:

“He's always calling out our plays & stuff like that. That's why we try not to run too many plays. He knows them all.”

Rick Carlisle on Rajon Rondo, May 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Carlisle on how this season's Clippers team vs last season's look:

“The structure of their team has changed slightly, but with the acquisition of Rondo they've gotten tougher,better defensively and they've added a playmaker... they're a contending team, there's no question.”

Rick Carlisle on Rajon Rondo, May 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Tom Thibodeau on Rondo's development early in his career:

“He took control, he let everyone know he was the point guard.... real student of the game, his ability to think on his feet as the game was unfolding was unique ... and he had the right enough of stubbornness to him.”

Tom Thibodeau on Rajon Rondo, May 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Monty Williams on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Monty Williams on what Rondo brings to the Clippers:

“Leadership. He's a champion, a two-time champion, been in every situation imaginable. He gets them organized on offense, just a really smart player on both ends of the floor.”

Monty Williams on Rajon Rondo, Apr 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Chris Finch on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:T'Wolves Coach Chris Finch on what he remembers from working with Rondo in Nola:

“I love Rondo. Just a high level competitor. He's played in so many meaningful games, the regular season bores him... you don't have to overcoach him -- just tell him what you're looking for.”

Chris Finch on Rajon Rondo, Apr 18, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Monty Williams on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Monty Williams on Rajon Rondo:

“He's a lot like Chris [Paul] in that way -- wherever he goes, he makes the team better.”

Monty Williams on Rajon Rondo, Apr 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Marcus Morris Sr. on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Marcus Morris Sr. on what he saw with Rajon Rondo in the lineup:

“He's gonna be a key piece to our run, him being in all these situations and seeing the game like he do.”

Marcus Morris Sr. on Rajon Rondo, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Paul George on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Andrew Greif:Paul George on Rondo's debut:

“You can just see his intangibles. he just sees plays happen. I saw a lot of energy and he hasn't played for a while ... I thought it made the game easier.”

Paul George on Rajon Rondo, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Frank Vogel, on Rondo getting traded to the Clippers.

“Rondo is like family to us. To me he always will be. I'll always root for him. Except when he's playing the Lakers.”

Frank Vogel on Rajon Rondo, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @hmfaigen.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Dennis Schroder on Rajon Rondo pushing the basketball into his forehead, drawing a technical foul today:

“I love competitors but that’s not competing.... I’m going to leave it at that ... That’s not basketball”

Dennis Schroder on Rajon Rondo, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Lloyd Pierce on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Lloyd Pierce on Rondo/Trae:

“Playing alongside and studying alongside a guy like Rajon is the necessary growth and the necessary mentorship that we can provide for Trae. It's part of the reason of why Rajon is here.”

Lloyd Pierce on Rajon Rondo, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @KLChouinard.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Kentavious Caldwell-Pope said via Zoom.

“That’s just Rondo. He does that for us. He quarterbacks for us and gets everybody in position.”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Rajon Rondo, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Rondo has been in this spot before, having won an NBA championship with the Boston Celtics in 2008 over the Lakers and having lost in the Finals to the Lakers in 2010.

“When Bron is out, [Rondo’s] pretty much commanding that floor, making everybody get in their spots, making sure everybody is where they need to be before we even run the play,”

Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on Rajon Rondo, Oct 1, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Rajon Rondo, Dwight Howard
item.description:
“You look at [Rajon Rondo], he’s 10 years removed from his last Finals, and Dwight [Howard] is 11 years out. I don’t want that to happen to me. I want to be here. I came to Los Angeles to contend for championships and I’ve put in the work to do so.”

Anthony Davis on Rajon Rondo, Dwight Howard, Sep 30, 2020. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
“Apparently, I guess because [Rajon] Rondo was talking s---, [William] decided he wanted to hop in, too.”

Russell Westbrook on Rajon Rondo, Sep 13, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
Lakers Nation:Frank Vogel on finding a secondary ballhandler with Rondo out:

“We have the ability to use our bigs with Kuz and AD to bring it up and handle, initiate offense.”

Frank Vogel on Rajon Rondo, Jul 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @LakersNation.

item.title: D'Angelo Russell on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
D'Angelo Russell:

“I would say [Rajon] Rondo. Rondo’s one of the guys that I’ve seen take care of his body in the offseason. I’ve seen him with the chefs and the meal preps, and I’ve just seen his work ethic. He’s definitely someone I’ve gotten a lot of jewels from.”

D'Angelo Russell on Rajon Rondo, Aug 27, 2019. Source: GQ.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Rajon Rondo
item.description:
“JaVale has been out, B.I. (and) Rondo has been out. Guys have been out throughout the season, so it is next man up.”

LeBron James on Rajon Rondo, Dec 26, 2018. Source: The Athletic.
